brief: Sponsor Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical. List its stopped (terminated, withdrawn or suspended) trials in the snapshot with phase, status, stated reason and whether results were posted.

findings.claim: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical has 9 stopped trials in the snapshot.
findings.notes: Count of stopped trials matching the sponsor string.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02618915 is Phase Phase 1/Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Sponsor decision; not due to any safety concerns related to DTX101."
Trial NCT02736188 is Phase Phase 3, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped is blank (NULL).
Trial NCT02731690 is Phase Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped is blank (NULL).
Trial NCT03216486 is Phase Phase 2, overall status WITHDRAWN, results posted: false, and why_stopped: "Administrative Reason".
Trial NCT02960217 is Phase Phase 3, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Study was halted prematurely due to lack of efficacy."
Trial NCT02599961 is Phase Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Study was halted prematurely due to lack of efficacy".

Trial NCT04088734 is Phase Phase 1/Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Terminated due to lack of efficacy seen in patients with advanced MPS IIIA disease. The patients will be followed up annually for safety until five years post dosing".
Trial NCT05312697 is Phase Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Sponsor decision not related to safety concerns".
Trial NCT04990388 is Phase Phase 1/Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, results posted: true, and why_stopped: "Sponsor decision not related to safety concerns".

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.sponsor ILIKE '%Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical%' AND d.stopped ORDER BY t.primary_completion_date
SELECT count(*) AS total_stopped FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.sponsor ILIKE '%Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical%' AND d.stopped
